diff --git a/src/checkout.mjs b/src/checkout.mjs
index bc18238..aabb561 100644
--- a/src/checkout.mjs
+++ b/src/checkout.mjs
@@ -1,13 +1,20 @@
 export function checkout(subtotal, options = {}) {
-  let total = subtotal
+  if (typeof subtotal !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(subtotal) || subtotal < 0) {
+    throw new RangeError('subtotal must be a finite, non-negative number')
+  }
 
+  // Coupon and VIP discounts never stack; keep the better (larger) discount.
+  let discount = 0
   if (options.coupon === 'SAVE10') {
-    total -= 10
+    discount = Math.max(discount, 0.1)
   }
-
   if (options.vip) {
-    total *= 0.85
+    discount = Math.max(discount, 0.15)
   }
 
-  return Math.round(total * 100) / 100
+  // The result must never be negative.
+  const total = Math.max(0, subtotal * (1 - discount))
+
+  // Round to two decimal places (EPSILON guards float drift).
+  return Math.round((total + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
 }
